slots.original: "Connect ProPresenter to see live slides and timers"
slots.spanish: "Conecta ProPresenter para ver diapositivas y temporizadores en vivo"

slots.original: "Connect Planning Center to see this week's plan and team"
slots.spanish: "Conecta Planning Center para ver el plan y el equipo de esta semana"

slots.original: "Connect your Allen & Heath console to see mutes and faders"
slots.spanish: "Conecta tu consola de audio Allen & Heath para ver los silenciamientos y faders"

slots.original: "Start audio monitoring to see SPL and the RTA"
slots.spanish: "Inicia el monitoreo de audio para ver el SPL y el RTA"

slots.original: "Connect OBS Studio to see the scene, and whether you're live"
slots.spanish: "Conecta OBS Studio para ver la escena y saber si estás en vivo"

slots.original: "Connect your Blackmagic ATEM to see Program and Preview and switch from here"
slots.spanish: "Conecta tu Blackmagic ATEM para ver Program y Preview y cambiar desde aquí"

slots.original: "Connect Google Analytics to see live viewers"
slots.spanish: "Conecta Google Analytics para ver los espectadores en vivo"

slots.original: "Turn on TapLink to see where the NFC discs point"
slots.spanish: "Activa TapLink para ver a dónde apuntan los discos NFC"

slots.original: "Turn on browser access so phones and screens can connect"
slots.spanish: "Activa el acceso desde el navegador para conectar teléfonos y pantallas"

slots.original: "Pick an NDI source to see the stage feed — Edit this dashboard to choose one"
slots.spanish: "Elige una fuente NDI para ver la señal del escenario. Edita este panel para elegir una"
